passages.text: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
The sons of Korah wrote this song.
The choirmaster leads this song.
The song follows the tune called Alamoth.

passages.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
passages.sermon:
This is a song for the choirmaster.
The sons of Korah wrote it.
They wrote it according to Alamoth.
God protects us.
God gives us strength.
God always helps us in times of trouble.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֑רַח עַֽל־ עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas, though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
passages.sermon:
God is our refuge and strength.
God is always present to help in trouble.
Therefore, we will not fear.
The earth may change.
Mountains may fall into the heart of the sea.
The waters may roar and foam.
Mountains may shake with their surging.
Selah.
A river flows through the city of God.
Its streams make the city glad.
This city is the holy place where the Most High lives.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן לֹא־ נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃ יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ־ הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃ נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

passages.text: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
passages.sermon:
God lives in the city of God.
God is present in the holy place where the Most High dwells.
The city will not fall.
God will help the city at the break of day.
passages.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־ תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
passages.sermon:
Nations rage.
Kingdoms fall.
God speaks with His voice.
The earth melts.
passages.original: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is with us.
The LORD commands the armies of heaven.
The God of Jacob is our fortress.
God protects us.
Selah.
Come and see the works of the LORD.
God brings devastation upon the earth.
God acts with great power.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־ לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ לְֽכוּ־ חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God stops all wars everywhere on earth.
God breaks every bow.
God shatters every spear.
God burns every shield in the fire.
passages.original: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד־ קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to all people.
God says, “Be still.
Know that I am God.
I will be exalted among the nations.
I will be exalted over all the earth.”
passages.original: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי־ אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is with us.
The LORD commands the armies of heaven.
The God of Jacob is our fortress.
God protects us like a strong fortress.
Selah.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־ לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
